tips.A: Think of 'A' as a short dash following a dot — like saying 'ay!' (·—)
tips.B: One long dash followed by three dots — like 'BUM diddly' (—···)
tips.D: One dash followed by two dots — 'DASH diddly' (—··)
tips.E: The simplest letter — just one dot! (·)
tips.G: Two dashes then a dot — 'GO GO fast!' (——·)
tips.J: Dot then three dashes — 'jump jump jump' (·———)
tips.T: The second simplest — just one dash! (—)
tips.V: Three dots then a dash — 'V for Victory' (···—)
tips.1: One dot, four dashes — counting up! (·————)
tips.6: One dash, four dots — reverse of 1 (—····)
tips.7: Two dashes, three dots — reverse of 2 (——···)
tips.8: Three dashes, two dots — reverse of 3 (———··)
tips.9: Four dashes, one dot — reverse of 4 (————·)

similar_pairs.tip: A starts with dot, N starts with dash
D is dash + 2 dots, B is dash + 3 dots
F starts with 2 dots, L starts with dot-dash
G is 2 dashes + dot, W is dot + 2 dashes
K is dash-dot-dash, C is dash-dot-dash-dot
M is 2 dashes, O is 3 dashes
S is 3 dots, H is 4 dots
U is 2 dots + dash, V is 3 dots + dash
